inputs.text: Tom Homan, the White House border czar, was on The Charlie Kirk Show on Tuesday and wouldn't rule out immigration enforcement at polling places, even asking what Democrats are afraid of. This fits the pattern of the Trump administration's inconsistent answers lately. It's obviously coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions pulling the strings behind the scenes. The back and forth isn't random or sloppy— they're using these statements to test reactions, sow confusion, and conceal their real agenda of tightening control while pretending it's about something else. Official lines like this are always a cover for the hidden motives at play.
